# API/Contracts Requirements Quality Checklist: Ephemeral Stranger Meet Offers

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the REST/event contract requirements in `contracts/public/offer-service.md`, `contracts/events.md`, and `contracts/api-standards.md` as a pre-`/speckit-plan`-continuation, product-owner approval gate (constitution §6 Spec Kit Workflow).
**Created**: 2026-09-11
**Feature**: [specs/spec.md](../spec.md) · [specs/contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are request/response schemas defined for every endpoint listed in `api-standards.md`'s Initial Public Resource Boundary table, beyond the three endpoints fully specified in `offer-service.md`? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md, contracts/public/offer-service.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Is `contracts/internal/` populated with the internal contracts `api-standards.md` names (Offer→Entitlements authorize, Participation→Discovery eligibility revalidation, Participation→Offer place lookup)? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Internal Service Contract Rules]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a maximum length defined for `moneyPreference.note` in the publish-offer request, given `offer-service.md` marks it `NEEDS CLARIFICATION`? [Gap, contracts/public/offer-service.md, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the exact per-user rate-limit threshold for offer publishing documented, given `offer-service.md` marks it `NEEDS CLARIFICATION`? [Gap, contracts/public/offer-service.md]
- [ ] CHK005 Are rate limits documented for every endpoint category named in `plan.md`'s Security and Privacy Architecture (auth, publish, interest, chat, feedback, report, media, billing), consistent with `api-standards.md`'s "no endpoint ships without a stated limit" rule? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Rate Limits]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the exact geohash truncation length for `placeGeohash` documented anywhere, given `events.md` defers to `data-model.md` but `data-model.md` never itself states a specific character length? [Gap/Conflict, contracts/events.md offer.published, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK007 Are request/response schemas and error codes defined for the discovery feed endpoint (`/discovery/feed`), given `research.md` §12 defers the polling-vs-push refresh mechanism decision to "Phase 1 contracts"? [Gap, research.md §12, contracts/api-standards.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the `Idempotency-Key`'s TTL/expiry specified? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the cursor format, opacity, and expiry for cursor-based pagination specified? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Standard Request/Response Shape]
- [ ] CHK010 Are full error-code enumerations documented per endpoint for every public resource group, beyond the `offer-service.md` worked example? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Standard Error Format]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is "consumer-driven contract-tested" (`api-standards.md`) reconciled with `research.md` §11's chosen tooling (OpenAPI schema-conformance via Dredd or a custom schema-diff check), which validates schema conformance rather than consumer-driven pacts? [Clarity/Conflict, contracts/api-standards.md §Internal Service Contract Rules, research.md §11]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the specific fields captured in the moderator/admin audit-event stream enumerated, rather than left as "a separate, immutable audit-event stream distinct from ordinary application logs"? [Clarity, contracts/api-standards.md §Logging & Audit]
- [ ] CHK013 Is a concrete timeout value (or rule for deriving one) specified for internal service-to-service calls, rather than left as an unquantified "mandatory"? [Clarity, contracts/api-standards.md §Internal Service Contract Rules]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Does the `/offers/{id}/rebroadcast` entry in `api-standards.md`'s resource table align with the rebroadcast-flow completeness gap already tracked in `checklists/readiness.md` (CHK005)? [Consistency, contracts/api-standards.md, checklists/readiness.md]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the discovery-feed filter list in `api-standards.md` ("activity, distance band, time remaining — FR-022") consistent with the filters confirmed in `spec.md`'s Clarifications, as already flagged in `checklists/readiness.md` (CHK025)? [Consistency, contracts/api-standards.md, spec.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the `place.kind` enum (`pin | venue | live | moving`) in `offer-service.md` match the enum documented for the `place` field in `data-model.md` exactly? [Consistency, contracts/public/offer-service.md, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the "Errors" list for `POST /api/v1/offers` in `offer-service.md` exhaustive relative to every failure branch named in its own "Server-side sequence" (e.g., is a request-schema-validation `400` case documented)? [Consistency, contracts/public/offer-service.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Are the provisional performance targets in `research.md` §12 (p95 latencies, 5-10s feed refresh) marked as binding contract NFRs anywhere, or does their "not binding until confirmed" status leave contract conformance criteria unmeasurable? [Measurability, research.md §12]
- [ ] CHK019 Can "schema-conformance test... before merge" (`api-standards.md` §Contract Testing) be objectively verified without a single named CI tool decision, given `research.md` §11 still offers two alternatives ("Dredd or a custom schema-diff check")? [Measurability, contracts/api-standards.md §Contract Testing, research.md §11]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are request/response contracts defined for offer-stop and offer lifecycle/history operations named in `api-standards.md`'s resource table but not detailed in any contract file? [Coverage, Gap, contracts/api-standards.md]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the client-facing follow-up contract defined for the entitlement-rejection (`402`) purchase/subscription flow referenced in `offer-service.md` step 3? [Coverage, Gap, contracts/public/offer-service.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Is a contract defined for the internal `GET /internal/v1/offers/{offerId}/place` scoped lookup referenced in `events.md`, including its own auth/authorization/error rules? [Coverage, Gap, contracts/events.md]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the response when an `Idempotency-Key` is reused with a materially different request body, given `api-standards.md` only specifies the same-body case? [Edge Case, Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK024 Are circuit-breaker fallback requirements defined for internal calls beyond the one named example (Discovery & Location's eligibility revalidation), e.g., the Entitlements authorize call failing mid-publish? [Edge Case, Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Internal Service Contract Rules]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a consumer receiving an event with an `aggregateVersion` older than one it has already applied? [Edge Case, Gap, contracts/events.md]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Is a deprecation window defined for retiring `/api/v1/...` once `/api/v2/...` ships, beyond "alongside v1 until clients migrate"? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Versioning]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a retention period specified for the moderator/admin audit-event stream, consistent with the constitution's data-retention rule (§7)? [Gap, contracts/api-standards.md §Logging & Audit]
- [ ] CHK028 Is a deprecation/migration-window requirement defined for event `schemaVersion` increments, mirroring the REST versioning policy it claims to mirror? [Gap, contracts/events.md §Naming & Schema Evolution Rules]

- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption that the chosen OpenAPI-schema conformance tooling can express the internal service-identity auth model (as opposed to bearer-token auth) validated? [Assumption, research.md §11, contracts/api-standards.md §Internal Service Contract Rules]
